plan: Given my private value of $4, I will place a conservative bid. Since my value is low, I aim to avoid winning to prevent a loss. I will bid slightly above my value to potentially outlast any lower bids but exit early enough to avoid overpaying. This strategy minimizes risk of loss when my value is low.

My value is $20. To maximize profit, I should bid below my value to ensure a positive margin if I win. The goal is to outlast at least one bidder but not necessarily both. A bid slightly below my value, such as $18, balances winning potential and profit margin, assuming others bid near their values.

Given my private value of $13, I aim to bid slightly below it to maximize profit while minimizing loss risk. I will bid $12, ensuring I exit before exceeding my value.
